faq.q: Can I bring my items to a branch?
faq.a: Yes. Walk-ins and drop-offs are welcome at our three branches. Check the opening hours before visiting.

faq.q: When does pickup operate?
faq.a: Pickup operates seven days a week, including holidays, from 7am to 5pm.

faq.q: Do you aim to collect on the same day?
faq.a: Yes. We aim to collect as soon as possible, usually the same day, unless you request another date. The team confirms the arrangements with you.

faq.q: What does the 11am cutoff mean?
faq.a: For Express/Same-Day Laundry requiring pickup for service that day, request collection by 11am. It is not a general cutoff for ordinary same-day collection requests.

faq.q: Is same-day service guaranteed?
faq.a: No. The team confirms availability, the fee and completion timing for your items.

faq.q: Where does my pickup request go?
faq.a: Pickup requests go to our main team, who arrange the appropriate branch.

faq.q: Is my booking confirmed when I submit the form?
faq.a: No. Your request is saved as pending until the team confirms the details with you.

faq.q: Do I pay on the website?
faq.a: No. The fee and payment arrangements are discussed with the team.

faq.q: Can I change my collection date?
faq.a: Contact our team to discuss a change to your request.

faq.q: Can I add photos?
faq.a: Yes. You can optionally add up to three photos, no larger than 5MB each, to your booking request.

faq.q: What is excluded from Wash, Ironing & Fold?
faq.a: Large items, bedding, wedding gowns, suits, Kente clothes, rugs and sneakers do not qualify for Wash, Ironing & Fold. Contact the team to discuss the appropriate service.

fields.Privacy preamble: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information.
fields.Privacy intro: This document outlines our commitment to transparency, ethical data governance, and the protection of your personal information across all 2nd Wave Laundry Services touchpoints.
fields.Privacy 1 body: We collect essential details required to fulfill your laundry orders, including your name, delivery address, phone number, and email address.
fields.Privacy 2 body: Your information is used strictly to process orders, coordinate pickups and deliveries, and communicate updates regarding your laundry. We never sell or share your personal data with third-party marketers.
fields.Privacy 3 body: Order history and contact details are securely stored for significant number of months to ensure a seamless repeat-customer experience and for accounting purposes. You may request the deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team.
fields.Terms 1 intro: We understand that plans change, and we aim to be as flexible as possible.
fields.Terms 1 list:
Free Rescheduling / Cancellation: You may reschedule or cancel your pickup free of charge up to 3 hours before your scheduled collection window.
Late Cancellations: Cancellations made with less than 3 hours' notice, or missed pickups where our driver arrives and cannot reach you, may be subject to a convenience or trip fee.
How to Change: Simply send us a message via WhatsApp or call our support line as early as possible to adjust your booking.
fields.Terms 2 intro: To help us manage our storage space efficiently and continue providing prompt service to all customers, we enforce a holding limit for finished laundry:
fields.Terms 2 list:
Storage Window: Completed orders must be picked up or scheduled for delivery within 30 days of the notification date.
Unclaimed Items: Any items left uncollected after 30 days despite reminder notices sent via WhatsApp, phone, or email will be considered abandoned.
Donation to Charity: To manage storage space, abandoned garments and laundry will be donated to local charitable organizations after the 30-day window has passed. We cannot accept liability for items donated under this policy.
fields.Terms 3 intro: We strive to maintain rapid response times, but technology and busy schedules can occasionally cause delays.
fields.Terms 3 list:
Primary Channel: WhatsApp is our primary communication channel for bookings, inquiries, and updates during our operating hours (7:00 AM – 8:00 PM).
Contingency Monitoring: If you have sent a WhatsApp message and have not received a reply within 30 minutes during our working hours, your request is actively managed through our backup systems:
Direct Phone Line: For urgent matters (such as an immediate change to an active pickup), please call our main support line at 059 522 4280 to speak directly with an attendant.
After-Hours Support: Messages sent after 8:00 PM will be logged and addressed first thing the following morning when we reopen at 7:00 AM.
fields.Care 1 intro: We treat every garment with the utmost care, following all manufacturer care labels. In the rare event that an item is lost or damaged, our process is designed to be fair and transparent:
fields.Care 1 list:
Reporting Window: Any claims regarding missing or damaged items must be reported within 48 hours of your delivery. Please inspect your garments promptly upon receipt.
Investigation: To file a claim, please send photos of the damage along with your order number via WhatsApp or email. Our team will review the garment's condition, care label, and processing history.
Compensation: If the damage is determined to be a direct result of our laundering process, compensation will be assessed based on the fair market value of the item (taking into account depreciation), up to a maximum limit of 10x the cost of cleaning that specific item.
Exclusions: We cannot assume responsibility for items with weakened fabric due to age or wear, items missing care labels, or items left in pockets (such as pens, tissues, or hard objects) that cause damage during the wash.
